root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: The decoded `status_flags` value must fit in one byte before it is narrowed into `sblock->status_flags` and the parser continues into the legacy address block.
root_cause_criterion.criterion: Legacy superblock deserialization may proceed past the status-flags field only when the decoded `status_flags` value is <= 255; otherwise the malformed superblock must be rejected before `base_addr`, `stored_eof`, and the root entry are trusted.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable witness decodes `status_flags == 0xff202000`, truncates it to the low byte, and continues into the legacy address block. The fixed original rejects that malformed value at the decode site, while the adjacent `status_flags_fit_zero` perturbation shows the same path genuinely executing when the decoded value is source-valid.

nodes.description: The legacy address block materializes `sblock->base_addr == HADDR_UNDEF` while `stored_eof` is still `10`, establishing the malformed address state that later wraps the default EOA.
After the malformed legacy address state is consumed, `H5F__super_read()` computes the wrapped default EOA argument `11` that downstream metadata loads use as the file bound.
The cache trims the speculative object-header read to `1` byte, which is smaller than the 4-byte `H5_SIZEOF_MAGIC` compare that the sink will perform.
The trimmed object-header load allocates a 1-byte heap-backed image buffer that becomes the object-header prefix parser input.
`H5O__prefix_deserialize()` reaches `HDmemcmp(image, H5O_HDR_MAGIC, H5_SIZEOF_MAGIC)` with the same heap image pointer allocated for the 1-byte object-header image.

edges.relation: The legacy address-block state `stored_eof == 10` together with `base_addr == HADDR_UNDEF` is consumed by `H5F__super_read()` and wraps the computed default EOA argument to `11`.
The wrapped default EOA value `11` is later read as `eoa` by `H5C__verify_len_eoa()` when the cache evaluates the root object-header load at address `10`.
The trimmed object-header length `1` is carried unchanged into `H5C__load_entry()`, which allocates the heap image of that exact size.
The same 1-byte heap image pointer allocated in `H5C__load_entry()` is passed unchanged into the `HDmemcmp` sink in `H5O__prefix_deserialize()`.
